text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} is out shopping one day.
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}が買い物をしている時だった──

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look who it is! Whattup, whiz-boy?
Whatcha doing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ヒデサイだ！
ちょす～
なにしてんの？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
You shopping? Oooh, so you're just out doing some
errands, then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
買い物ちう？
あぁ、
おつかい頼まれたんだね。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: So like, why the long face, huh? You're lost?
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
キョロキョロして、
どったの？
……お店の場所がわかんない？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Aw, B!
Then how about I show you the way?
Where to first?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか。
じゃあ、
うちが手伝ってあげよっか。
まずはどこ行くの？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
You want some fruit? Well, it's like, right around
the corner! Easy peasy, lemon squeezy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
果物屋？
だったら、
すぐそこじゃん。
よゆ～
よゆ～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
See? What'd I say? So what's on the shopping list?
Just three apples? You sure that's gonna be enough?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
ここだよ。
何買うの？
リンゴ３個？　
え、
少なくない？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's only seventy rupies per apple.
That's like, stupid cheap. You should get some more!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だってほら、
一個70ルピだよ？
こんなに安いんだから、
もっと買ってよくない？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Lessee... nine's the biggest number on the times
table, and seven times nine is forty-six... Right! If you buy
nine apples, it's only 460 rupies!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
一番大きいのが９で……
７×９＝46だから、
９個買っても、
460ルピだよ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Yeah, I know this one, at least. Forty-six and seven and nine! 
What's your name and what's your sign! ♪ 
See? It's super easy to remember!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～、
そんなことないよ。
シチクヨンジュウロク……
シクヨロ～
って覚えてるし！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Inorite? So like, why not just buy it in bulk?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でしょ？
たくさん買ったほうがお得だって！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Then let's do this thing!
Hey, mister! Can I get nine apples please?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
買っちゃうよ。
すみませ～ん、
リンゴ９個くださ～い！

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text: Nine apples, coming right up. That'll be 630 rupies.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいはい、
リンゴ９個ね。
630ルピになります。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Bwuh?! 630?! Wait, are you for serious?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ウソッ！？
630……
マジで！？

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text: And here's your change. Thanks for your patronage.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
これおつりね。
まいどあり～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Sorry... I messed up my math again. The sevens
table is just like, really hard.
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………ごめん。
うち、
計算間違えちゃった……
九九の７の段、
苦手なんだよね。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
You're not mad? You are like, the sweetest guy ever,
whiz-boy. But like, what about money? You've still
got stuff you wanna buy, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……許してくれるんだ？
ヒデサイって、
おに優しいよね。
でも、
お金大丈夫？　
まだ買う物あるんだよね？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
You don't have enough? Oh geez...
Um. What are we gonna do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
残りの買い物には足りない……？
そっか……
う～ん、
どうしよっか？

text_block_list.name: Promoter
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the grand opening of our new casino!
Come on down, and take a look inside!
text_block_list.orig_text:
本日、
新規オープンのカジノで～す！
どうぞ、
寄っていってください！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Whiz-boy, that's it! I just got a great idea!
Why mourn the loss of your money when you can just
get more?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～！
ヒデサイ、
あれだよ、
あれ！
ルピが足りないなら、
増やせばいいんじゃん！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
I thought you'd say that, you little brain genius,
you! We are like, so in sync!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイなら、
ノッてくれると思ってた！
決まりだね。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Oh, it'll be fiiine! Que Sarah Sarah, right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へーき、
へーき！
うちらなら、
なんとかなるって！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
So what are we waiting for?
Let's casino it up, baby!
text_block_list.orig_text:
というわけで、
さっそくカジノへ、
しゅっぱ～つ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Hellaaa! We hit the jackpot again!
Lady Luck just can't get enough of us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やり～！
また大当たり～！
きょうのうち、
マジでカミッテル！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, let's see a smile, whiz-boy!
We're killing it, my guy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイもよろこびなよ～！
大儲けだよ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
I'm not like, the brightest crayon in the shed or
anything, but casinos are super easy, huh? 
Give 'e a number and they just give you money!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よくわかんないけど、
カジノって簡単だね？
適当な数字にかけたら、
どんどん当たっちゃった！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: C'mon, whiz-boy! We gotta bet more! MORE!
choice_data_list: Papa needs a new pair of shoes!
Maybe we should reel it in...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねねね、
ヒデサイ！
せっかくだから、
もっと増やしちゃおうよ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Love the enthusiasm, my guy! Let's do this thang!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ノリノリだね！
この勢いで、
当てちゃお～！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Wimping out isn't a good look on you.
Go big or go home is what I always say!
text_block_list.orig_text:
弱気はよくないって。
ガンガンいっちゃお～！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna put it all on B4,
'cause like, I was born in April!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
次は黒の４に全賭けね。
うち、
４月生まれだし。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
And there goes the roulette!
Come ooon four! Four! [i]Four![/i]
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ルーレット回った！
４来い！　
４来い！！　
４来～い！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so sorry. We were doing so good, but then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ごめん。
最後の最後に外しちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
We lost everything... Now we definitely can't go
shopping. I never should've let myself get
so greedy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
チップ全部なくなっちゃったし、
これじゃあ買い物できないね……
うちが欲張らなかったら……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
You mean it? 'Cause actually, I thought it was
pretty fun too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんと？
うちも、
すっごく楽しかった！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Like, it was a [i]blast[/i] when we started hitting it big,
but having it all come crashing down at the end...
Ahaha! It was totally hilarious!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大当たりも楽しかったけど、
最後に外しちゃうとか……
あはは！　
超わろ～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: But, uh... You gonna be okay? What about your errands?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～、
でもどーしよ？
買い物の続き、
できなくなっちゃったね？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You can just get a refund? Oh, right! You can
just give some of the apples back! Doy! Whiz-boy,
you are a genius!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
返品すればいい？
あ、
そっか。
お店にリンゴ返せばいいんだ！
さすがヒデサイ、
頭いい～！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The two of them apologized profusely to the shopkeep,
returned the apples, and went back to their shopping.
text_block_list.orig_text:
店主に謝りながら返品し、
なんとか買い物を終える二人であった。
